cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Hide Inside the Callback
cards.instruction: Use an early harmless detail as the explanation for each new consequence, keeping your own role outside the pattern.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put that cup down. It's caused enough trouble with your letter already.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You poured it over the letter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because it was full to the edge. Next time leave room at the top; that is where this went wrong.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You filled it, and you were holding it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then keep it away from me while you dry the letter. We've established it becomes a problem the moment I get near it.
